    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", 0) or 0

        s = 0

        for i in range(len(rt) - 1):
            c += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for r in routes:

    routes = []

        route = []
        load = 0
        current = depot

            feasible = [node for node in customers if load + demands[node] <= capacity]
            if not feasible:
                break
            # tie-break by demand/node for determinism

            route.append(nxt)
            customers.remove(nxt)
            load += demands[nxt]
            current = nxt
        routes.append(route)

    # ---- targeted evolution 1: deterministic savings-style merges between routes ----
    def ends_orient_savings(r1, r2):

            # r1seq and r2seq are the sequences to use in concatenation
            # concat_left means r1seq is used as-is; concat_right means r2seq used as-is in this concatenation
            return (matrix[depot][r1seq[0]] + matrix[r1seq[-1]][depot] +
                    matrix[depot][r2seq[0]] + matrix[r2seq[-1]][depot] -
                    (matrix[depot][concat_left[0]] + matrix[concat_left[-1]][concat_right[0]] + matrix[concat_right[-1]][depot]))

        r1_rev = list(reversed(r1)) if l1 > 1 else r1[:]
        r2_rev = list(reversed(r2)) if l2 > 1 else r2[:]

        # Orientations: A=r1 or rev, B=r2 or rev
        cand = []
        # A: r1, B: r2
        d = delta(r1, r2, r1, r2)
        cand.append((d, r1, r2))
        # A: r1, B: rev(r2)
        d = delta(r1, r2_rev, r1, r2_rev)
        cand.append((d, r1, r2_rev))
        # A: rev(r1), B: r2
        d = delta(r1_rev, r2, r1_rev, r2)
        cand.append((d, r1_rev, r2))
        # A: rev(r1), B: rev(r2)
        d = delta(r1_rev, r2_rev, r1_rev, r2_rev)
        cand.append((d, r1_rev, r2_rev))

        # return best delta > 0 if any
        cand.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], len(x[1]), len(x[2])))
        d_best, a_best, b_best = cand[0]

                    if lb + demands[x] > capacity:

                        nc = route_cost(new_b)
                        if best_ins is None or nc < best_ins[0] or (nc == best_ins[0] and ins_pos < best_ins[1]):
                            best_ins = (nc, ins_pos, new_b)

                    new_a_cost = route_cost(new_a)

        routes[a] = new_a
        routes[b] = new_b
        loads[a] = new_la

        return routes, loads, True
